title: Server tool-group extraction Phase 1
claim: FP-MCP-352 Phase 1 completed a behavior-preserving extraction of seven low-risk read-only/status/list/diagnostic MCP tools from src/server.ts into grouped registrars without changing the registered tool surface.
summary: Copilot performed the first bounded MCP bridge refactor phase in /home/ridasaidd/forgepilot-chatgpt-mcp only. The phase moved forgepilot_status, forgepilot_get_opencode_status, forgepilot_get_opencode_capabilities, forgepilot_list_packets, forgepilot_list_runs, forgepilot_read_file, and forgepilot_get_mcp_runtime_diagnostics into src/tool-groups/status-tools.ts, src/tool-groups/read-tools.ts, src/tool-groups/diagnostic-tools.ts, and src/tool-registry/index.ts. Verification showed pnpm test passed and tool registration parity remained 68 -> 68 with identical sorted names, no additions, no removals, and no duplicates. Bridge commit e768e44 records the implementation.
caveats: This was Phase 1 only, not a complete server.ts normalization.
Runtime registration order was not treated as the proof criterion because the audit concatenation order differed; the sorted tool surface and absence of additions/removals/duplicates were preserved.
No high-risk tools were moved in this phase.
The bridge branch remains ahead of origin until pushed manually if host push tooling remains blocked.
boundaries: Did not modify /home/ridasaidd/forgepilot during Copilot implementation.
